This is bounded visible-fragment capture, not standard-adapter BOUNDED_COMPLETE or a full provider trace.
scope: Exact independently checked visible text tokens of the current human authorization, 60/40 role correction and accepted AI proposal. No model call, manuscript/rubric change or generated-result rerun. All original bootstrap artifacts and failed standard capture remain.
stages: Use distinct research.selection.stage events for the five substantive stages. Existing philosophy-round adapter requires whole accepted native message records and cannot represent this fragment capture. Its administrative checkpoint will retain INCOMPLETE; final finite acceptance is a dedicated receipt, not an assertion that old gaps disappeared.
